Hierarchical flowchart showing the administrative set-up of the Northern Protectorate. Top box: "High Commissioner (British)". Line down to: "Resident (British, in charge of a Province)". Line down to: "District Officer (British)". Line across from the District Officer to a box saying: "Emir / Native Authority (Traditional Ruler)". Below the Emir, lines branch to "Native Courts" and "Native Treasuries".
